description: TransferWise/Wise 'BALANCE CASHBACK' / 'general' credits on the business account -- REDONE per explicit user correction: one voucher per individual bank line (exact date + exact cent amount), no date-grouping, so Lexoffice's automatic bank matching (Kontenabgleich autodetect) can pair each voucher to its bank transaction 1:1. Supersedes the earlier grouped version (9 vouchers), which the user deleted because grouped sums didn't match individual bank lines. Excludes 'Usmaan Khan / Sent via Wise / -1.940,68 EUR' (2025-05-20) -- a real outgoing payment via Wise, not a cashback credit, explicitly flagged by the user as a different matter, not booked here. Wise issues no invoice/receipt for cashback; each voucher is backed by a generated Eigenbeleg PDF (scripts/generate-eigenbeleg.py) for exactly that one transaction. Booked as voucherType 'purchasecreditnote' (expense reduction) against 'Nebenkosten des Geldverkehrs', 0% VAT (rebate on a VAT-exempt financial service carries no VAT of its own).
